sourceItems.title: MLCC或遭遇严重缺货 市场望迎涨价潮
normalizedClaims: Murata cut production capacity for legacy MLCC products with smaller substitutes to about 50% of 2017 capacity and planned further reductions.
The change followed Kyocera product exits and was expected to worsen MLCC shortages.
observedChanges: legacy MLCC effective supply contracts materially

sourceItems.title: MLCC持续涨价 需警惕价格操纵
normalizedClaims: Japanese suppliers' product-mix shift was estimated to release roughly 20% of standard MLCC market demand to other suppliers.
Yageo was reported to plan another roughly 40-50% MLCC price increase from April after multiple earlier increases.
observedChanges: shortage translates into repeated realized supplier pricing

sourceItems.title: 传国巨4月起被动元件涨40~50%
sourceItems.publisher: 自由财经/工商时报信息
normalizedClaims: Channel reports said Yageo planned an April 1 all-series MLCC price increase averaging 40-50%, above February's 10-20%.
Industry participants said common specifications remained tight because major Japanese suppliers were reducing standard-product capacity.
observedChanges: supplier pricing power remains strong into the next quarter

sourceItems.title: 供需失衡持续 金属钴2018年上涨态势将延续
normalizedClaims: Domestic metal cobalt was about RMB575.7k/t on Feb 1, +7.7% YTD and nearly triple the July 2016 level.
Supply was highly concentrated globally and industry participants expected limited near-term supply growth.
observedChanges: cobalt scarcity persists but price absorption is already extreme

sourceItems.title: 1-2月挖掘机销量21800台，增长14.3%
sourceItems.publisher: 中国路面机械网/行业协会数据
normalizedClaims: Jan-Feb excavator sales were 21,800 units, +14.3% YoY; exports were +108.25%.
Sany sold 4,571 excavators with 20.97% share, the largest among reported brands.
observedChanges: machinery demand remains positive from a high base and exports accelerate

sourceItems.title: Apple set to halve first-quarter iPhone X production target: Nikkei
normalizedClaims: Nikkei reported Apple told suppliers it would cut Q1 iPhone X production target from more than 40m to around 20m units because holiday-season sales were weaker than expected.
observedChanges: premium-smartphone component demand is revised sharply lower

sourceItems.title: Apple supplier Murata says iPhone X output target cuts overstated in report
normalizedClaims: Murata said its own iPhone X-related orders had not fallen by as much as the reported production-target cut, providing an explicit contradiction to the most extreme demand interpretation.
observedChanges: smartphone-demand weakness is real enough to investigate but magnitude is disputed

sourceItems.title: Server DRAM Prices Will Continue to Rise as Server Demand from China Boosts in 2Q18
normalizedClaims: 1Q18 server-DRAM quotes were expected about +4% QoQ and prices were expected to keep rising in Q2.
TrendForce expected China server demand to grow strongly in Q2, around 20%, while supplier transitions limited price increases but kept the market tight.
observedChanges: server-memory demand/price state remains positive into Q2

sourceItems.title: President Trump Announces Strong Actions to Address China's Unfair Trade
normalizedClaims: The U.S. announced Section 301 actions including a proposed tariff list, WTO action and investment restrictions.
The proposed tariff process would target Chinese goods after notice/comment rather than becoming immediate company-level earnings changes on March 22.
observedChanges: macro trade-policy risk rises abruptly without a stable company-level earnings mapping

sourceItems.title: Section 301 Fact Sheet
normalizedClaims: USTR described proposed 25% duties on a future product list covering areas including aerospace, ICT and machinery; final products would follow a public process.
observedChanges: policy uncertainty broadens but exact listed-company exposure is unresolved at cutoff

eventClusters.statement: Major Japanese MLCC suppliers were withdrawing/reducing legacy standard-product capacity while Taiwanese suppliers repeatedly raised prices, creating a measurable upstream supply-state contraction before many downstream listed-company earnings reports fully reflected it.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The shortage is visible and price increases are repeated, but listed-company promotion must still prove direct MLCC exposure, realized earnings conversion and expectation room rather than treating all passive-component names as beneficiaries.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can a listed A-share MLCC producer show cutoff-valid realized earnings plus a direct capacity/price bridge while the broader sector has not fully absorbed the supply contraction?

eventClusters.statement: Cobalt remained supply-constrained and highly concentrated, but metal prices had already risen dramatically over 18 months, creating a useful high-absorption/late-cycle test.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Physical scarcity is real, but current commodity price may already capitalize much of the supply imbalance. Deep research must distinguish still-underreflected company earnings from chasing an extreme commodity rerating.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does any A-share cobalt expression retain a clean earnings/valuation gap after the commodity's large prior move?

eventClusters.statement: Jan-Feb excavator sales remained positive on a very high prior-year base, exports more than doubled, and Sany retained leading market share.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: February was down YoY because of holiday/high-base effects, so deep research must avoid treating one headline as a clean acceleration. Company earnings/valuation and March reacceleration must be cutoff-valid to promote.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Are leader company engines strong enough that high-base physical demand remains actionable by March 31?

eventClusters.statement: Reports indicated a sharp Q1 iPhone X production-target reduction, but a major component supplier disputed the magnitude, creating a negative-demand signal with explicit uncertainty.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The production cut is reported rather than first-party Apple guidance and its magnitude is disputed. Do not map generic Apple-supply-chain shorts/longs without company-specific order/earnings evidence.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does the smartphone-demand revision create any clear A-share earnings deterioration or is evidence too conflicted for selection?

eventClusters.statement: Server DRAM demand and prices remained firm into Q2, with China server demand expected to accelerate while supplier transitions kept supply tight.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: A positive global Server DRAM price state does not automatically map to A-share semiconductor beneficiaries; company exposure and earnings conversion must be verified.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there any direct A-share expression with measurable earnings conversion from server-memory tightness, or should the Skill fail closed?

eventClusters.statement: The March 22 Section 301 action sharply increased China-US trade-policy risk, but the exact tariff list and company-level earnings transmission were not yet final at cutoff.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The policy shock is large but cross-sectional company exposure is unresolved before the proposed tariff list. Treating broad exporters/import-substitution names as direct beneficiaries/losers would over-map a macro event.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can any company-level earnings path be verified by cutoff, or should this remain a broad risk observation without selection?

evidenceDocuments.title: 风华高科2017年度业绩预披露/预升
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 风华高科/公开业绩预告
normalizedClaims: Cutoff-valid disclosure put 2017 attributable profit at about RMB207.685m, +49.51% YoY.
The company attributed improvement to favorable passive-component markets, MLCC/chip-resistor orders exceeding supply, higher sales, capacity expansion and product/customer-mix improvement.
The much stronger 2018Q1 profit forecast was not published until April 10 and is explicitly excluded from the freeze.

evidenceDocuments.title: 风华高科 cutoff expectation-burden reconstruction
normalizedClaims: Historical March 30 close was about RMB16.39; public share count was about 895.233m.
Using the cutoff-valid 2017 profit estimate RMB207.685m implies a rough trailing/provisional earnings multiple around 70x before any April Q1 forecast was public.
This is a burden diagnostic, not a claim that forward 2018 earnings were known at cutoff.

evidenceDocuments.title: 火炬电子2018年第一季度业绩预增公告
normalizedClaims: Company guided 2018Q1 attributable profit to about RMB54.25m, +50% YoY, and ex-item profit to about RMB51.25m.
Reasons included rising military-customer orders and persistent component shortages that were difficult to resolve in the short term, helping gross margin and trading-product sales.

evidenceDocuments.title: 三环集团2017年度业绩快报
normalizedClaims: 2017 revenue RMB3.131bn +8.45%, attributable profit RMB1.0845bn +2.39%.
Growth came mainly from ceramic handset back covers and ceramic package bases; the flash did not yet provide a cutoff-valid MLCC earnings acceleration comparable with the later April Q1 forecast.

evidenceDocuments.title: 华友钴业2017年度业绩预增公告
normalizedClaims: 2017 attributable profit was guided to RMB1.65-1.90bn, +2283% to +2644% YoY.
Company cited rising cobalt prices, higher cobalt-product capacity, product-mix optimization and lower manufacturing costs.

evidenceDocuments.title: 华友钴业首次覆盖报告
normalizedClaims: At March 21 price RMB122.73, forecast 2017/2018/2019 EPS 3.02/5.49/7.20 and PE about 40.6x/22.3x/17.1x.
Forecast 2018 net profit RMB3.255bn, +81.8%, while noting cobalt-price and project-delivery risks.

evidenceDocuments.title: 寒锐钴业2018年第一季度业绩预告
normalizedClaims: 2018Q1 attributable profit was guided to RMB246.15-260.87m, +395.05% to +424.65% YoY.
Company cited cobalt capacity expansion, higher cobalt demand/prices and copper/cobalt line upgrades.

evidenceDocuments.title: 三一重工2017年度业绩预增公告
normalizedClaims: 2017 attributable profit was guided to RMB2.03-2.11bn, +898% to +937% YoY; ex-item profit RMB1.76-1.86bn.
The disclosure reflects realized cycle earnings rather than a later Q1 result.

evidenceDocuments.title: 恒立液压2017年度业绩预增公告
normalizedClaims: 2017 attributable profit was guided to RMB370-400m, +425.94% to +468.59% YoY.
Company cited strong downstream demand, higher cylinder utilization/sales and volume growth in new hydraulic pump/valve products.

evidenceDocuments.title: 工程机械行业深度研究：关注行业龙头投资机会
normalizedClaims: Using March 27 data, Sany 2018E/2019E PE was about 18.01x/13.90x; Hengli about 29.29x/22.68x.
The report expected 2018 to remain a strong profit year but explicitly treated the industry as a mature recovery rather than a fresh initial cycle.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen 2018Q1 MLCC price regime
normalizedClaims: MLCC basket was favorable: +11.81pp 20d excess and +18.14pp 60d excess with 100% breadth. Fenghua itself had +18.40pp 20d and +29.13pp 60d excess.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen 2018Q1 cobalt price regime
normalizedClaims: Cobalt basket was favorable: +2.10pp 20d and +32.55pp 60d excess with 100% breadth; Huayou itself had +48.67pp 60d excess.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen 2018Q1 machinery price regime
normalizedClaims: Machinery basket was neutral: -1.24pp 20d and +0.68pp 60d excess; Sany had +0.18pp 20d but -9.14pp 60d excess, a mechanical early-turn pattern.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen 2018Q1 Apple/smartphone-chain price regime
normalizedClaims: Apple-chain basket was neutral: -0.41pp 20d and -3.66pp 60d excess, with mixed cross-section.
